reasoning: The question asks whether the 90-day average SOFR will increase between October 11 and October 18, 2026 (a 7-day window). The 90-day average is a rolling 90-calendar-day compounded average, so it changes gradually as new daily SOFR values are added and old ones drop off. A 7-day change in a 90-day rolling average is typically small. Without knowing current SOFR levels or Fed policy expectations, the probability of any directional move is close to 50%, with a slight bias toward stability. Given the short timeframe and the smoothing nature of a 90-day average, increases and decreases are roughly equally likely, though the magnitude of change would be small either way.
